nodes.name: Weekly Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs every Monday at 9 AM. Update via the admin dashboard Automation section.

nodes.name: Execute Now Webhook
nodes.notes: Triggered by the admin dashboard 'Run Now' button via POST /api/v1/n8n/execute. URL: {n8n-url}/webhook/seo-blog-execute

nodes.name: Fetch Next Keyword
nodes.notes: GET /api/v1/blog-keywords/next — returns the highest-priority pending keyword and marks it in_progress. Returns { no_work: true } when queue is empty.

nodes.name: Has Pending Keyword?
nodes.notes: Stops workflow gracefully if no pending keywords remain.

nodes.name: Normalise Keyword
nodes.notes: Extracts and normalises keyword fields from the API response for downstream nodes.

values.content:
=You are a senior SEO editor writing production-ready content for a live website.

Write approximately {{ $json.target_word_count }} words (stay within ±10% of that target) for the primary keyword: "{{ $json.keyword }}".

QUALITY AND TRUST (E-E-A-T):
- Sound authoritative and precise; avoid vague claims and invented statistics
- Prefer concrete examples, checklists, and clear definitions over filler
- If you mention tools, standards, or regulations, name them accurately; do not fabricate citations or URLs

SEO AND STRUCTURE:
- One clear H1 containing the keyword; use the keyword in the first 100 words and in at least 3 H2s where it reads naturally
- Weave in these LSI terms where relevant (do not keyword-stuff): {{ $json.lsi_keywords }}
- Match search intent: {{ $json.intent }}; topic cluster context: {{ $json.cluster }}
- Use a logical H2/H3 outline; keep paragraphs short (2–3 sentences) for readability
- Include one comparison table OR one numbered step list with real utility
- Add an H2 "Frequently Asked Questions" with 3–5 items: each question as h3, answer as following p
- End with a decisive call to action (what the reader should do next)

STYLE:
- No emoji; no AI clichés ("in today's fast-paced world", "in conclusion", "delve", "landscape", "unlock")
- Active voice, second person "you" where appropriate
- Output only valid, semantic HTML: h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, strong, em
- Do not wrap the HTML in markdown code fences (no ``` or ```html). No commentary before or after the HTML
- The article body must stay on-topic for the target keyword only

BRAND VOICE:
Authoritative, clear, and reader-first. Practical over promotional; minimal jargon; explain terms when needed.

Output only the HTML article.

nodes.name: Generate Article
nodes.notes: First AI pass: writes the full SEO blog post.

values.content:
={{ "Based on the article below, generate a JSON object with EXACTLY these keys: meta_title, meta_description, slug, featured_image_alt, image_search_query, excerpt.

Rules: meta_title <= 60 chars, same topic as the article H1, title case. meta_description 150-160 chars, one soft CTA. slug lowercase hyphens, <= 60 chars. featured_image_alt <= 125 chars for screen readers. image_search_query 4-7 words, literal photo scene. excerpt <= 200 chars, plain text, no HTML.

Never put automation tool names, n8n, workflow, or the words Pick / Next / Keyword together as a prefix in any field value.

PRIMARY KEYWORD (use naturally in SEO fields only):
" + String($('Normalise Keyword').first().json.keyword || '') + "

ARTICLE:
" + String($json.message.content || '') + "

Return ONLY valid JSON. No preamble. No markdown fences." }}

nodes.name: Generate SEO Meta
nodes.notes: Second AI pass: generates meta title, description, slug, alt text using gpt-4o-mini.

nodes.name: Merge Article + Meta
nodes.notes: Combines article HTML and SEO JSON into one payload for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Fetch Pexels Image
nodes.notes: Free Pexels API. Move the key to n8n Credentials for security.

nodes.name: Pick Best Thumbnail URL
nodes.notes: Uses original/large2x when available so images are sharp on retina. Stores the URL directly — no upload step needed.

nodes.name: Prepare Post Data
nodes.notes: Strips markdown fences, prepends hero img tag, and builds the JSON body for POST /api/v1/blogs.

nodes.name: Create Draft Blog
nodes.notes: POST /api/v1/blogs with x-api-key header. Creates a draft post you can review and publish in the dashboard.

nodes.name: Mark Keyword Published
nodes.notes: PATCH /api/v1/blog-keywords/:id/complete — marks the keyword as 'published' so it won't be picked again.

nodes.name: Notify Slack
nodes.notes: Slack notification with a link to the dashboard. Replace YOUR_FRONTEND_URL.
